title: Itsuki Nakano Totem
description: Custom made Itsuki Nakano totem made by PurpleRamune
body:
Thanks Gem_ for the help! 

In my opinion Nakano Itsuki should've gotten with Futaro in the end. But its whatever. 

The ingame name for the totem is Itsuki Nakano instead of "Totem of Undying"

Also the totem is scaled down to reduce screen coverage when popped. 

2nd version contains her star and hearts as totem pop particles
1st does not.
